hardware_variation.assumptions: Each episode holds one leg at 87–95% nominal torque, the opposite at 98–104%, plus independent joint variation of ±2 percentage points. In each 32-case block, each release band covers every combination of weak side, 0/5 ms extra target delay and saved/absent calibration. Each of the next 32 cases swaps the matching command speed. Encoder errors span ±0.7° per leg joint, with matching servo internal feedback and reported encoder readings. IMU roll/pitch errors span ±1.5°, gyro biases ±0.3/0.3/0.6°/s. These ranges are assumptions.
hardware_variation.release: Random 50 Hz release ticks in four duration bands; 3.5 s of neutral command. Sustained stop uses the 100 Hz run_audit criterion. Each heel gets the same cases and mismatch as its comparators. Execution and actor order are seeded and shuffled.
